# Md. Roushan Alam | AI Product Builder | Systems & Intelligence Studio

> Official website: [https://www.mdroushanalam.in](https://www.mdroushanalam.in)

## Who is Md. Roushan Alam?

Md. Roushan Alam is an AI Product Builder and systems thinker based in India. He deconstructs complex business and operational problems into autonomous AI architectures, digital products, and growth systems. Rather than claiming credentials, his work demonstrates intelligence through deep research investigations, prototype system blueprints, and live interactive sandboxes.

He studied history (BA History, BBMKU Dhanbad, 2024), pursued UPSC civil services research, trained frontier AI models at RWS Group (RLHF, alignment, benchmark verification), and now engineers full-stack intelligent systems.

He is actively building Astra Humanis (https://astrahumanis.in), a long-term venture into ambient machine intelligence and multi-modal spatial perception.

## Core Specializations

1. **Applied AI Systems**: Domain-specific reasoning agents, small language model (SLM) fine-tuning, deterministic confidence-gating pipelines, and knowledge retrieval architectures.
2. **Digital Products**: High-leverage MVPs, internal operational tools, and AI-native interfaces.
3. **Growth Infrastructure**: Behavioral intent scoring, automated lead qualification, and programmatic acquisition funnels.
4. **Operations Automation**: 3-way invoice reconciliation, exception routing, and async event-driven orchestration.

## Active Ventures & Explorations

- **Astra Humanis**: [https://astrahumanis.in](https://astrahumanis.in) - Ambient machine intelligence, physical sensor fusion, and spatial perception.
- **TechGram**: [https://www.techgramedu.in](https://www.techgramedu.in) - AI-native education ecosystem and adaptive learning architectures.
- **Gig-Lo**: [https://giglo.in](https://giglo.in) - Next-generation recruitment and gig workforce platform.
